facades.name: podzidom_printshop
facades.source: Street View Sep 2011 (rectified from 2 frames, pano gAL62ns6LbO495WAvU7CaA)
facades.look: the north-west side of Pod zidom: a tall grey concrete modernist apartment block of 1930s type in weathered grey render, six bays of horizontal ribbon windows with dark roller shutters and white curtains behind glass, four bands of windows, a projecting canopy over the ground floor. At the far LEFT a beige building with a rounded corner balcony (green detail) and a red-and-white shop sign reading 'SVJET obuće'. Ground floor of the grey block from LEFT to RIGHT: a dark fascia with white script letters 'Mondiš' under a grey-and-white striped awning, a big glazed shop front under a dark fascia with white capital letters 'PRINT-SHOP' and a small 'DICK' logo in the window, a blue square parking sign with a white 'P', and a wide garage door of dark timber with glass panes. At the far RIGHT a white plastered neighbour house with a sign reading 'PALATINO ART GALERIJA' and a brown awning. Copy exactly.
